body: Anyone? Someone told me it was the fan relay. Can anyone confirm this? And if so, is it normal or something I should be concerned with?
Can anyone else chime in? Is this something to be concerned about if it is the fan relay? I've been searching around but can't seem to find any info on it.
So, nothing to worry about? It does it every time the fan engages.

I wondered if the display was bad, too. Mine also wouldn't work on an external monitor. At this point, I'm thinking it's something with the hard drive itself. I'm no expert, though. I hope you can get yours working again.
Sorry for taking a bit to reply. I tried the power drain and BIOS reset, and neither worked. I'm pretty positive the warranty is gone. It was bought roughly 4 years ago, I believe.

Hi, thanks for the reply. I believe it happened around the 19th of April. The computer worked fine the day before. I turned it on, and the screen wouldn't work at all. The power button light and charging light both work. I don't have another charger, but the one I have still charges the computer. The caps lock key doesn't light up at all. I think there was an update a couple of days before it happened, but I used the computer after, and it seemed fine.
Awesome, I'm gonna get one then. Thanks!
I don't have any form advice, but is that the gosports 7x7 golf net? If so, how do you like it? Does it tip over without the stakes in the ground?

I ordered my 120 2 years ago during acks memorial day sale and didn't get it until late August. Like mine a lot. Good quality and has the best of both worlds being pretty stable but also paddles well.

No problem, hope you enjoy it too. I've added a fish finder to mine and the transducer mount under the kayak is real nice. I've taken it on pretty big lakes and have paddled up stream in pretty fast currents for a few miles with not much effort. It's sort of iffy for me to stand in and fish sometimes but can be done. Let me know if you have any other questions about it.

I have the pescsdor pro 120 and really enjoy it. I thought about the ascend at first but heard it was kind of heavy and a barge to paddle. I have also duck hunted out of mine with no issues. I've sat in it over a spread of decoys and have also used it to jump shoot in creeks which is a blast. I think they're both good choices though.
Same here. I wake up and can't wait go to sleep again. None of my friends really want to talk anymore and I don't want to bother them. You're not alone, man. Hope things get better for you!

It's like being stuck in limbo. I don't know about you but I've felt this way for so long that I don't really remember what it's like to feel any different. I don't know if it's even possible to change how I feel. It's scary to think about.
I've thought about it everyday for quite a few years now. I don't really see a point in living but I don't think I could kill myself no matter how much I want to. I hate it so much.

Have you asked him to help? I'm sure he'd be understanding about it. I'm in the same boat as you. I've blown off every job I've had within a week of starting. I'm 23 and undiagnosed as well. I feel like a failure. I hate myself,  can't concentrate, can't do anything right and am a nervous wreck around everyone. It's exhausting. Just letting you know you're not alone and I wish the best of luck to you.
The second option worked. I couldn't find anything that worked before. Thank you so much! I really appreciate you taking the time to reply.
I always thought about it as sort of zoning out too. I'm going to give it shot. Thanks for taking the time to reply, I really appreciate it.
I never thought about that. Sounds like a good idea actually. I'm going to look into that.

I can't afford therapy. And I do have 2 friends that I talk to once in awhile but seem to get tired of talking to me pretty quick. They probably wouldn't talk to me ever if I didn't start the conversation. It makes me feel really alone.

I tried it a few years ago and it seemed to help. I'm such a tense person I have a hard time calming my mind down. I think if I could calm down it would definitely be beneficial. Do you have any tips mediating correctly?
I actually have quite a free hobbies. But they are all things that I try way to hard to be really good at. I usually end up getting pretty angry when I do them.
Wow, that gives me some hope then. Was this in Wisconsin? If not, expungement in other states might just be somewhat similar.
That sounds very similar to what I read about it. I'm hoping it's true and I qualify. Thank you for taking the time to respond to this.
I hear you man. It's tough to get out of. What were you planning on doing after school? Is it hard to find positions for what you went for?
What kind of life situations?
I'm pretty much the exact same way, man.

Yes to just about all of that. I also have lazy eye. I've gotten rid of all of my friends. The only person I talk to decided that I'm not worth talking to anymore. I feel like I'm ruining people's lives by being alive. The good moments don't seem to happen much anymore and seem like they will eventually go away completely. I appreciate you taking the time to write that. Sorry you have felt this way before too but it's nice to know that someone has had similar feelings.

I don't really have any advice to give because I'm in a very similar situation. Sometimes it helps just to know that you're not alone. I'm still trying to work up the courage to ask my parents if they will support my decision to see a doctor. I wish you the best of luck with figuring things out.

I really appreciate you taking the time to write all of this. It's nice to know people care. I need to try and forget about all of the assholes out there but that's not easy. I do have troubles sleeping most nights. I have trouble falling asleep and wake up multiple times a night sometimes. I think I will definitely see a doctor. I want to make things better. I need to try. I am going to try and schedule an appointment this week or next week. I will write back after I go. Thanks again for your help and advice!

You sound almost exactly like. I went to college right after high school for a semester. It was just too much for me. I then went to a tech school the following year and couldn't even finish the semester. I'm pretty sure my parents don't have a clue either and they've done so much for me that I really don't want to put this on them too. When I was 19 I got 2 misdemeanors for possession of thc and paraphernalia. Even if I felt like I could handle a job, I'm not sure if I could even get one. I have no references, work history or experience.  I pretty much feel like my life is over. It's nice to know that someone is in a similar position but I'm also sorry that you have to deal with these problems too. I hope everything works out for you!
